concerns.text: Corrupted leftover editing artifacts inside the scenario: 'The specific value to remove/generalize: 'k'' and 'Rewritten passage:.' appear mid-requirement, truncating the R²/500-iterations acceptance clause. This is broken prose that makes the scenario unparseable.

FR-001 mandates 'a feature matrix of ≥200 2D topological descriptors', while FR-007 mandates iteratively removing the highest-VIF feature until all VIF ≤ 5.0. VIF pruning on a 200+ descriptor set will almost certainly remove many features, so the two FRs can be simultaneously unsatisfiable. Clarify whether the ≥200 floor applies pre- or post-collinearity pruning.

Undefined term 'the generated D descriptors' — 'D' is never defined anywhere in the spec; elsewhere the same concept is called '2D descriptors' / '2D topological descriptors'. Terminology should be stable.
SC-003 says 'Jaccard similarity of the top SHAP features' while FR-005 and US-3 specify 'top 10 SHAP features'. Align the wording (state 'top 10' in SC-003) so the measured quantity is unambiguous.
